name: Altwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Altwirt is situated in the centre of Kematen in Tirol, approximately ten kilometres west of Innsbruck. Managed as a traditional inn with guest rooms, it embodies the classic style of a Tyrolean country inn. Dining spaces include a cosy parlour and a beer garden, welcoming hotel guests and passing visitors alike. The kitchen focuses on traditional Tyrolean dishes prepared mainly with regional ingredients. The rooms are practically furnished, offering the standard amenities typical of country inns in this category. The location in Kematen makes an excellent base for activities in the Inn Valley, including hiking and cycling. Guests can enjoy a relaxed atmosphere and genuine hospitality.
